orgs.name: HNRNPU Foundation
orgs.snippet: HNRNPU is a gene on chromosome 1q44 that encodes a protein called heterogenous nuclear ribonucleoprotein U (hnRNPU).

orgs.name: Better Future 4 U (BF4U)
orgs.snippet: Better Future 4 U is a nonprofit organization dedicated to advancing understanding, awareness, and research around HNRNPU neurodevelopmental disorder.

orgs.name: HNRNP Family Foundation – HNRNPU-RNDD
orgs.snippet: We are running a Natural History Study for HNRNPU-RNDD at the HNRNP Family Foundation.

orgs.name: Simons Searchlight – HNRNPU
orgs.snippet: HNRNPU-related syndrome is also called developmental and epileptic encephalopathy 54, or HNRNPU-related neurodevelopmental disorder (HNRNPU-NDD).

orgs.name: Human Disease Genes – HNRNPU
orgs.snippet: There are no gene-specific treatments to date for HNRNPU-RNDD.
